unexpected_observations: 'Network restored' is only half true in this harness: every ePrint HTML path succeeds and every ePrint PDF path is Cloudflare-challenged, and web.archive.org is blocked by egress policy, so the usual fallback is unavailable. Future tasks should budget for HAL / institutional-repository / Zenodo mirrors.

The paper was retitled between revisions: cited in 2023 as 'Faster dual lattice attacks by using coding theory' (Carrier, Shen, Tillich) and now titled 'Assessing the Impact of a Variant of MATZOV's Dual Attack on Kyber' (four authors, Meyer-Hilfiger added). Program records reconciling the 2023 objection literature with the current paper need this.

Ducas-Pulles measure a heavier-than-predicted tail ('waterfall-floor') in the wrong/uniform-target score survival function, with the floor beginning earlier than the contradictory-regime frontier in small dimensions. Same kind of quantity as Pwrong and the deviation runs toward more false candidates than predicted, but a different attack, score function and variable, so it transfers nothing. Recorded only as bearing on why the KN-OPEN-016 residual is worth measuring.

The lane is active, not saturated: ePrint 2026/1400 and 2026/1326 build directly on this attack family and 2026/599 proves a code-based analogue without a model. There is no basis in the retrieved record for treating this direction as mined out (docs/inventor-protocol.md, premature closure).

Visible only from the primary source: the current abstract states 'we fully back up our analysis with experimental evidences' while the only experimental validation of Pwrong (Figure 4.1) spans T in [200, 1600] at n = 43/50 with kfft = 3, whereas Table C.2's CC Kyber-512 row asserts log2(Pwrong) = -119.57. An observation about the paper's own stated scope, not a claim that the analysis is wrong.

Byte-identity is itself a small positive result: the HAL object the findings were derived from has not changed since it was vendored, so none of KN-FIND-012/013/014/016 was derived from a copy that has since been silently replaced.
